security_audit.summary: Most backtick findings are false positives from Markdown fences or inline MCP tool names. The real risks are the npx-based MCP install, the external setup URL, and contextual misuse for unsolicited outreach.

remediation.issue: MCP install uses npx to execute an npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the package version, document the package source, and advise users to review the package before install.

remediation.issue: Setup instructions rely on a hardcoded external URL.
remediation.suggestion: Use a verifiable official documentation URL and explain what users should expect before downloading anything.

remediation.issue: Lead discovery and outreach guidance lacks consent safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to follow platform rules, respect consent, and avoid unsolicited or deceptive messages.

static_findings.snippet: - Start with `check_status_and_login` to confirm the account is ready.
- Use `list_products` before searching so results match the right offer.
- Use `search_keyword_for_leads` or `analyze_video_comments` to collect customer signals.
- Use `query_leads` to review saved leads and buying intent.

content.user_title: Find Customer Leads From Short-Video Comments
content.value_statement: Manual lead discovery from short-video comments is slow and easy to misread. This skill guides PPXC through keyword generation, intent review, lead lookup, and outreach preparation.
actual_capabilities: Checks PPXC connection status and login readiness.
Suggests customer-discovery keywords for product offers.
Searches or analyzes short-video comments for buying signals.
Queries saved leads and reviews buying intent.
Exports diagnostics for support or verification.
limitations: Requires a PPXC account and configured MCP server.
Results depend on available products, accessible comments, and PPXC data quality.
Does not verify identity, consent, or contact permissions for leads.
Outreach scripts need human review for compliance and brand fit.

use_cases.title: Start a Product Lead Search
use_cases.description: Select a PPXC product, generate search angles, and find comments with buying signals.

use_cases.title: Analyze Comment Demand
use_cases.description: Review short-video comments to understand customer pain points and intent strength.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sales Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Query saved leads, rank intent, and draft compliant outreach scripts for review.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Leads
prompt_templates.prompt: Find customer leads for my product in PPXC. Start by checking connection status and listing available products.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Keyword Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Use PPXC to suggest customer-discovery keywords for this offer. Group them by pain point, intent level, and search angle.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Comment Intent
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze short-video comments for this product. Rank leads by buying intent and summarize why each lead appears relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Build Outreach Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my PPXC customer pool, segment high-intent leads, draft outreach scripts, and include next actions for follow-up.

output_examples.input: Find leads for my skincare product.
output_examples.output: A lead research plan with product selection, keyword angles, comment intent signals, and outreach messages for review.
A ranked summary of likely buyers, their visible needs, supporting comment signals, and suggested next actions.
Short outreach drafts grouped by lead intent, with reminders to respect consent and platform rules.

best_practices: Connect PPXC and select the correct product before searching.
Review lead context manually before outreach.
Use consent-aware messaging and follow platform rules.
anti_patterns: Do not contact people without a lawful or platform-approved basis.
Do not treat comment intent scores as verified purchase intent.
Do not share diagnostic exports outside trusted support channels.

faq.question: Does this skill require PPXC?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects a PPXC account and MCP setup before lead discovery can run.

faq.question: Can it search every social platform?
faq.answer: No. Search coverage depends on the sources available through PPXC and the configured MCP server.

faq.question: Does it send messages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares outreach scripts and next actions for a human to review and send.

faq.question: Can it rank lead intent?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review saved leads and comment signals to help rank likely buying intent.

faq.question: Is it ready for regulated industries?
faq.answer: Use extra review. The skill does not provide legal, privacy, or industry compliance approval.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
